finalText:
It builds clean now, 0 errors.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`. It tried to set `maxRetries: retries`, but `retries` was never defined there — it should have read `env.retries`, the value passed in. That's what crashed the link step under all the noise.

I changed it to `env.retries`, and now the build finishes with 3 warnings, 0 errors.
